propositions: Non-create operation families (update, delete, probe, clean-label, repair-property, conflict) must route through the coordinator and fuse instead of legacy ad-hoc retry, with an internal per-family rollback selector and no dual-send.
Explicit deferral metadata (scope, reason, retry_not_before) must be persisted and emitted for matching remaining work while independent scopes continue without blocking.

The new endpoint-failure scoped fuse must be integrated with the blast-radius mass-mutation guard (classify.check_blast_radius) retained unchanged, and exact applied/failed/deferred/skipped/recovered tallies with degraded-pass signaling must be produced.

All per-mutation guards (lost-lease abort_check, HEAD-drift recheck, rebar-id audit) and batch-precondition guards (cross-project, blast-radius) from legacy _apply_batch must be preserved at the same invocation points.

Historical replay of the sanitized 1,200-run completed GitHub Actions slice must show zero premature termination of observed successful or partially successful jobs, counting only normalized terminal outcomes.

Venue-gated Cloud/DC verified-fake tests must assert wire order, call ceilings, tallies, logs, and exit status through the coordinator cutover before the default internal operation-family value flips from legacy to coordinator.
